summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria verified. 9 browser checks + 5 backend tests (2 files), all passing.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 1 — Places topographic map renders real map visuals with clickable location nodes
checks.name: places-topographic-map-nodes
checks.evidence: topographic-map-svg visible with landmass silhouette + contour paths; 5 map-svg-node-* nodes present; clicking a node changes selected-location-hud-card content.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 2 — Admin logout navigates to public home; login screen has back-to-site link
checks.name: admin-logout-navigates-home
checks.evidence: Logged in via ENTER STUDIO, clicked admin-logout-button, URL left /admin entirely (back to '/'). admin-back-to-site-link was visible on login screen.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 3 — Film modal locks/restores body scroll on open/close
checks.name: film-modal-scroll-lock-restore
checks.evidence: document.body.style.overflow === 'hidden' while film modal open; reverted to '' after clicking close-film-modal-button.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 4 — No emoji in rendered body text on /, /places, /collections, /reels
checks.name: no-emoji-in-body-text
checks.evidence: Regex scan of innerText on all 4 pages found zero emoji code points.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 5+6 — Home motion (scroll rail, hero, parallax count-up) + page-title headings across sections
checks.name: home-motion-parallax-countup
checks.evidence: scroll-progress-rail attached, cinematic-hero-section visible, philosophy-parallax-section scrolled into view and stat-works-archived counted up to a non-zero value.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX 5+6 (page titles) — page-title testid visible with text on /explore /collections /places /films /reels /stories
checks.name: page-titles-render-on-all-sections
checks.evidence: page-title element visible with non-empty text on all 6 routes.

checks.criterion: FEATURE — Archive-wide instant search palette (tag/category chips, mist results incl. collection nav, gibberish no-crash)
checks.name: search-palette-tags-and-results
checks.evidence: search-palette-overlay opened via button; tag/category chips shown empty-state; 'mist' produced search-result-media-* and search-result-collection-*; clicking collection row navigated to /collections/*; 'zzzqqq' showed 'No works match' message without crash.

checks.name: test_tscheck_search_discovery.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/discovery/search?q=mist -> 200, total=7, media>=1, collections includes 'Mist Over the Western Ghats'; q=zzzqqq -> 200, total=0 empty arrays; GET /api/discovery/facets -> 200 with tags[].

checks.criterion: FEATURE — Per-collection ambient percussion score toggle (label change, no console errors)
checks.name: ambient-score-toggle-plays-stops
checks.evidence: ambient-score-toggle visible on collection detail with tuning label; clicking switched text to contain 'PLAYING'; second click reverted; zero pageerror events captured.

checks.criterion: FEATURE — Fine art print room (sizes/frames/price/preview, validation, success), inquiry-only
checks.name: print-room-request-flow
checks.evidence: print-card clicked -> print-request-modal open with 5 print-size-* and 4 print-frame-* options; selecting a size changed indicative price from ₹9,500 to ₹16,500; empty submit blocked (validation message shown, no print-request-success); filled name+email -> print-request-success shown.

checks.criterion: FEATURE — Print inquiry backend (submit success, validation rejection), no payment step
checks.name: test_tscheck_print_inquiry.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/inquiries with tscheck-print-buyer-* name/email/message -> 200/201; POST /api/inquiries {} -> 422 with missing name/email/message in detail.

notes: Backend test suite (5 tests across 2 new files, in addition to pre-existing scaffolding) passed in 0.71s.
9 browser checks all passed on first or second attempt after selector adjustments (no application bugs found).

Spec deviations honored per briefing: no payment step in print room, no Instagram auto-sync, ambient score is Web Audio synthesis, /admin/dashboard not route-guarded — none of these were reported as bugs.
